thread:
maya: Heads-up — seeing a spike in 5xx + auth failures for hosted inference in eu1 starting ~12:03 UTC. P95/P99 latency climbed, customers timing out. Anyone seeing network alerts?
ops-bot: alert: hosted-inference-eu1 gateway 5xx spike detected (12:02 UTC). 502/504 rate +18%.
aditya: @maya grabbing net logs. Early look: p95 RTT jump between eu1-azb <-> eu1-azc, high retransmits. Could be provider queuebloat or ECMP imbalance.
kyle: I see auth-token upstream retries spiking at the same window, likely cascading timeouts.
aditya: Sample mtr/traceroute from proxy -> backend path (trimmed):
```
mtr -r -c 5 gateway.eu1
1. 10.0.0.1    0.3%   1.2 ms
2. 192.0.2.45 10%   120 ms
3. 198.51.100.12 60% 350 ms  (loss at ISP hop)
4. 203.0.113.2 0%    40 ms
```
aditya: Loss + large queuing delay at hop 3 — looks like provider-side queuebloat or shaping.
sam_cs: Customer ACME reported repeated 502s and billing webhook retries. They're escalating; asking for ETA and mitigation.
maya: Mitigation options: fail traffic to eu2, prefer alternate peer, or enable degraded fallback model to reduce token pressure. What's quickest?
sre_lead: Immediate plan: (1) bias BGP pref to avoid suspect transit ASN, (2) increase gateway retry backoff to reduce auth storm, (3) notify CS + customers. aditya/kyle run the net changes.
aditya: Pushed BGP preference to avoid ASN 645xx for eu1-egress at 12:18 UTC. Monitoring now.
ops-bot: metric update: 5xx rate down 45% over last 12m post-route-change. p99 latency trending down.
kyle: Auth errors reduced after route pref change — looks effective. We'll keep the pref for now and open provider ticket.
sam_cs: I informed ACME; they report fewer failures. They want a short summary for the account exec.
maya: Marking mitigated at ~12:30 UTC. Follow-ups: provider RCA request, collect full packet captures, evaluate ECMP weights and AQM (fq_codel) with provider. Assign to aditya + net team.
aditya: I'll pull pcaps and agent traces, and open an RFC with the transit provider. Also propose running inter-AZ perf sweep to validate ECMP distribution.
maya: Thanks — please add remediation checklist and ETA in the incident doc. cc: @sre_lead @kyle
summary: eu1 hosted inference 5xx spike caused by provider-side queuebloat/packet loss at a transit hop. Mitigated by BGP pref change to avoid the transit ASN and retry/backoff tuning. Customer impacted (ACME) notified; follow-ups include provider RCA, packet captures, and ECMP/AQM checks.
